name: Gitar
scene: An elegant acoustic guitar leans gently inside an oval stained-glass panel surrounded by flowing musical waves.
notes: Design sheet only. Guitar uses amber/terracotta; background uses blue/teal. Inspected both generations; one revision requested to remove shading, increase pane count and add an opaque white exterior. Final image has a closed oval rim and no apparent loose line ends. Remaining doubts: subtle fill variation persists; some same-colour adjacent pieces will merge during tracing; some closely spaced or multi-way contacts, especially beside the neck and in background waves, need geometry review. Target is 99–139 panes; a rough raster connected-component estimate gives 151 interiors before same-colour merging, not a validated traced pane count. No game catalogue changes.
